next.reason: 1985 lets a report file be opened OUTPUT and EXTEND in one run unit, each reopen preceded by a CLOSE 'without the REEL, UNIT, or LOCK phrase'. 2023 allows a report file in 'the OPEN statement with the OUTPUT or EXTEND phrase' (§2023:13.18.46.3 SR3); OPEN requires 'The file connector referenced by file-name-1 shall not be open' (§2023:14.9.27.4 GR2) and only 'a CLOSE statement without the UNIT phrase' ends the open mode (§2023:14.9.6.4 GR8), REEL and UNIT being equivalent (§2023:14.9.6.3 SR2). 2023 CLOSE has no LOCK phrase, so that exclusion is moot. Same requirement, run-time in both.
